notes.note: Titan rejects access to the promoted field p.y; promoted fields of embedded fields are defined in clause 6.2.1.4 (V4.17.1), which Titan does not implement. Warning considered wrong.
Absence of element identifiers is tested negatively: an assignment notation with a field identifier for a record of value is rejected.
Reading 1 (every position up to the last list member is a value or '-') tested positively.
Checks only that trailing elements are not bound after the assignment (not isbound), which holds under both readings (kept uninitialized or removed); the length is not checked.
Reading 1 chosen (index shall be less than the upper length bound): index 3 on a record length(3) of type is rejected.
Spec allows a semantic or runtime error; the access goes through a function parameter so that it can only be detected at runtime, expected verdict error.
Reading 1 chosen: a value with uninitialized elements is used only transiently (filled before sending), so sending it succeeds. The error case is covered by 6.2.3.0-032a.
Reading 1 chosen per example 3: assignment notation on the right hand side vs. index notation on the left hand side give the same result.
